items.title: After the ‘martyr’s’ funeral: The families left behind by Yemen’s war
items.description: Rising fatalities in Yemen’s conflict deepen the burden on families of fighters, both emotionally and financially.

items.title: How has the ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky been unfolding?

items.title: Stranded locals use rare truce to leave Moscow-occupied town in Ukraine
items.description: Some residents of Oleshky, a Russian-occupied town in southern Ukraine ravaged by food and medicine shortages, left on Friday during a rare ceasefire brokered by the United States – due to end on Sunday evening. items.title: Aid Deliveries and Evacuations in Oleshky Begin After Demining Operation Wraps Up
items.description: Ukrainian and Russian officials said a humanitarian convoy is ready to depart for the besieged town in occupied southern Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine peace momentum builds, but Russia sticks to its guns
items.description: The United States may be pushing a peace plan for Ukraine and Russia, but neither country seems interested in discussing it – especially Russia.

items.title: World News in Brief: 5 children killed in Sudan, Haiti hunger emergency, Yemen war update
items.description: At least five children were killed and two others injured in a drone attack on a market in Nyala, in Sudan’s South Darfur state, on Monday, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

items.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
items.description: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.

items.description: On Wednesday, President Volodymyr Zelensky said the proposed energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia never took effect because Moscow continued striking Ukrainian energy infrastructure. items.title: Russian Drone Attack Kills 14 In Dnipro As Oleshky Truce Enters Third Day
items.description: A Russian attack on Ukraine's eastern city of Dnipro killed at least 14 people and injured more than 10 others, according to Ukrainian officials, as a fragile cease-fire around Russian-occupied Oleshky entered its third day on October 29.
